blocks.source: Source: MLS® data from the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® and the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board, compiled by SnapStats®. Rank counts only communities with at least ten homes listed. Falling listings with steady sales mean homes are being absorbed faster; rising listings with steady sales mean more choice for buyers. A sellers’ best bet is a community where homes sell quickly against the number listed; a buyers’ best bet is the reverse. Sales ratio is homes sold divided by homes listed. On the reports’ own scale under 12% is a buyers’ market, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% is a sellers’ market. With fewer than ten homes listed, one sale moves the ratio a long way, so treat it as a rough signal.

blocks.text: Between June 2026 and October 2026, detached houses: listings was 2 in June and 2 in October, too few (under 3) to call a rise or fall, and it took 4.3% of the city’s 46 sales over the period; condos and townhomes: listings was little changed, 7 in June and 7 in October (+0.0%), and it took 7.8% of the city’s 77 sales over the period.

blocks.text: Condo buildings in North Meadows PI
District = SD42 Maple Ridge–Pitt Meadows.
Streets, schools and getting around North Meadows PI

items.t: The closest official planning name for its southern edge is the North Lougheed Area (approximately 50 ha north of Lougheed Highway between Meadows Gardens Golf Course and Harris Road).

Where condo stock concentrates: it does not concentrate — there is one complex. The Fairways sits on Meadow Gardens Way at the edge of Meadow Gardens Golf Course on the sub-area's south edge; the rest of the sub-area is RS/RR houses and A-1/A-2 farm properties in the Pitt Polder.

Transit: the R3 Lougheed Hwy RapidBus stops at Harris Road on the south edge; route 701 runs via Harris Road and Hammond Road along the south edge to Pitt Meadows Station; route 719 serves Wildwood Crescent and Hammond Road. There is no West Coast Express station in this sub-area (Pitt Meadows Station is south of Lougheed Highway), and no bus route serving the rural north itself was confirmed.

Schools and catchments: SD42 catchments are address-based, and SD42 has no middle tier in Pitt Meadows (elementary K–7, then secondary). Highland Park Elementary, 18961 Advent Road, is physically in the sub-area; Pitt Meadows Secondary, 19438 116B Avenue, sits south of the sub-area. For the sample address 18961 Advent Road, the SD42 School Locator returns Highland Park Elementary and Pitt Meadows Secondary. Any other address is not verified until run.

Parks: Harris Road Park, 12474 Harris Road (concession, spray park, skate park, playground, walking trail, ball diamonds, outdoor pool, basketball court); Grabenhorst Garden, 13895 Harris Road; the Codd Island Wetlands, undiked floodplain wetlands on the Alouette River in the rural north, are on the City heritage register.

Health: the nearest hospital is Ridge Meadows Hospital, 11666 Laity Street, Maple Ridge (24/7 emergency); the Ridge Meadows Urgent and Primary Care Centre is at 121-11900 Haney Place, Maple Ridge, open 9:00 a.m. to 8:00 p.m., 7 days a week. Pitt Meadows has no hospital.

Flood/ALR setting: over 95% of Pitt Meadows is in the floodplain per the City's 2020 Business Plan, protected by roughly 60 km of dikes, and this sub-area is the low Pitt Polder land drained by floodboxes and pump stations (Alouette Pump Station, Fenton and Pitt Polder catchments). Most of the city's land falls within the Agricultural Land Reserve.

blocks.text: Good to know about North Meadows PI

items.t: The board line on Advent Road cuts across the street. Anyone searching "55+ Pitt Meadows" by street will land on Advent Road; anyone searching by board sub-area will not find it under North Meadows.

Two near-identical names, two tenures, one street. Meadowland Village (18960 Advent Rd) is the buyable 55+ strata; Meadowlands Housing Co-operative (19032 Advent Rd) is a 55+ co-op where members hold shares and nothing is ever listed as a strata sale. Both are board-classed with Central Meadows and covered there.
The city's floodplain figure has two live versions.

The golf-course condos are the sub-area's only strata — and the count is not settled. The Fairways' developer figure is 268 homes, counts conflict across sources, and its registered age position is not confirmed — three separate facts a listing sheet will present as settled. The strata plan (BCS2427) and Form B are the documents that settle all three.

The rural north has no bus. Confirmed transit is all on the Lougheed/Harris south edge (R3, 701, 719); the Pitt Polder farm roads have no confirmed route at all, which matters for any buyer planning to age in place without driving.

The North Lougheed Area Plan is adopted but not built. OCP Amendment Bylaw No. 3060, 2026 covers roughly 50 ha north of Lougheed Highway, and the City states development will proceed gradually with further planning, studies and Council approvals — no residential presale in the sub-area was verified.

Well and septic are per-lot questions. Whether a given North Meadows lot is on municipal water/sewer or on a well and septic system is not confirmed per lot on an official source — check the provincial GWELLS well records and Fraser Health's onsite-sewerage rules (only an Authorized Person can design, install, repair, maintain or inspect a system) before subject removal on a rural lot.

blocks.text: Condo buildings in North Meadows
The Fairways — 19673 and 19677 Meadow Gardens Way

A resort-style condominium complex on the edge of Meadow Gardens Golf Course, developed by Magusta Development, whose own portfolio page describes "an exclusive collection of 268 resort-style homes" built around a courtyard, with a Residents' Club overlooking the golf course offering exercise facilities, a massage space, a lounge and kitchen, and a games room. MLS listing records for units at both addresses record sub-type Apartment/Condo, subdivision name The Fairways, year built 2007, title to land Freehold Strata, and amenities including clubhouse, exercise centre, sauna/steam room, bike room, guest suite, caretaker and in-suite laundry; one listing records a new roof in 2022. Pet position is listing-level only: listings describe the complex as pet friendly, record "Cats OK", and one ground-floor listing states "one dog or up to two cats welcome" — a verified building bylaw summary is not confirmed. Rental position: no building-level rental restriction is published in the sources checked — and any long-term rental bylaw would in any case be void under the Nov 24, 2022 rule in. Age restriction: no source checked publishes a 55+ bylaw for The Fairways, and listings market the complex to families and professionals and list a kids playroom among the amenities — do NOT treat The Fairways as a 55+ complex; a registered-bylaw age position is not confirmed until the Form B is read.
Streets, schools and getting around North Meadows

items.t: "North Meadows" — styled "North Meadows PI" in the guide feed labels — is an MLS® sub-area name for the part of Pitt Meadows north of Lougheed Highway (Highway 7), covering the Highland Park and Wildwood residential areas, Harris Road north, and the rural Pitt Polder lands beyond; the City does not publish a boundary for it, and the closest official description is the North Lougheed Area, about 50 ha on the north side of Lougheed Highway between Meadows Gardens Golf Course and Harris Road. No official boundary: Not verified.

Where the condo stock concentrates: one pocket only — Meadow Gardens Way, on the edge of Meadow Gardens Golf Course, where The Fairways stands. The rest of the sub-area's feed runs to large farm acreages on Richardson Road and Hale Road and boat-access-only cabins on Debeck Creek at Pitt Lake; whether the board draws the sub-area as wide as Pitt Lake on purpose is not verified.
There is no West Coast Express station in this sub-area, and no bus route serving the rural north itself was confirmed: Not verified.

SD42 has no middle tier (elementary K–7, secondary 8–12) and catchments are address-based; the recorded locator run for 18961 Advent Road returned Highland Park Elementary and Pitt Meadows Secondary, plus French Immersion options. Catchments for other addresses: Not verified.

Parks and anchors: Harris Road Park, 12474 Harris Road / 12474 Lougheed Highway (spray park, skate park, outdoor pool, diamonds); Grabenhorst Garden, 13895 Harris Road; Codd Island Wetlands on the Alouette River, on the City heritage register; heritage sites include the Japanese Canadian Hall, 19089 Advent Road, and the Pitt Meadows School House, 13414 Harris Road. No library branch is in this sub-area — the city branch is Pitt Meadows Public Library, 200-12099 Harris Road.

blocks.text: Local rules that affect condo buyers in North Meadows

items.t: Floodplain and ALR: the City's 2020 Business Plan states over 95% of the Pitt Meadows land base lies within the floodplain for the Fraser River and, to a smaller degree, the Pitt River — the guide page's "over 85%" Financial Plan figure is superseded and retired here. The city is almost entirely protected by 60 km of dikes; the northern drainage areas (Alouette Pump Station catchment, Fenton, and the Pitt Polder catchment) are drained by floodboxes and pump stations, and the Codd Island Wetlands are undiked floodplain wetlands. The same Business Plan states 78% of the city's land falls within the Agricultural Land Reserve; on ALR land the Agricultural Land Commission allows one additional detached residence without an application where one residence already exists when construction begins, to a maximum of 90 sq m on properties 40 ha or less.

blocks.text: Good to know about North Meadows

items.t: This sub-area's feed runs from a golf course to a lake. Two of the guide feed's first twelve listings are boat-access-only cabins on Debeck Creek at Pitt Lake, labelled "North Meadows PI" — the same sub-area label as The Fairways condos at the city's urban edge. Whether the board draws the sub-area that wide on purpose is not verified, and the cabins are not condo stock.

The Advent Road school and the Advent Road 55+ pocket are in different sub-areas on paper. Highland Park Elementary stands at 18961 Advent Rd inside North Meadows, while the Meadowland Village / Meadowlands co-op pocket further along Advent Road is board-classified Central Meadows. Street name alone does not settle sub-area — the board label on the listing does.

The floodplain figure has a stale twin on the guide page. The City's 2020 Business Plan states over 95% of the land base is in the floodplain; the guide page's Planning section quotes a Financial Plan 2026–2030 figure of "over 85%". The 95% figure governs.

The Codd Island Wetlands are undiked. Unlike the diked urban and farm land around them, the Codd Island Wetlands on the Alouette River are undiked floodplain wetlands on the City heritage register — flood protection in the rural north is pump-and-floodbox drainage, not a uniform dike ring.

Rural servicing is a per-lot question. Whether a given North Meadows lot is on municipal water/sewer or on a well and septic system is not confirmed per lot on an official source: Not verified. Well records can be checked in the provincial GWELLS application, and an onsite sewerage system must comply with the Sewerage System Regulation.

blocks.text: Local rules that affect townhome buyers in North Meadows PI

items.t: : SPA s.59 — fees, amounts owing, approved special levies, CRF balance, insurance summary; rules, budget, Rental Disclosure Statement, most recent depreciation report attached; within 7 days, max $35 plus up to 25¢/page. At The Fairways the Form B/strata plan (BCS2427) is also where the conflicting unit count and the not confirmed age position are settled.

Rental-restriction bylaws VOID: since Nov 24, 2022 — any directory "rentals not allowed" line for a Pitt Meadows strata is VOID for long-term rentals. Separate city layer: short-term rentals are PROHIBITED in Pitt Meadows — a city rule the strata-law voiding does not cure.

City zoning/OCP: Pitt Meadows Zoning Bylaw No. 2505, 2011 — A-1 General Agricultural min lot 8 ha (one farm house to 500 m² GFA); A-2 min 16 ha; RR-2 4 ha, RR-3 2 ha, RR-4 1 ha (RR = land outside the ALR); RS Large Lot Residential min 0.2 ha. One garden suite per lot (33–90 m²) in A-1/A-2/RR-1–RR-5/RS zones (garden suite OR secondary suite, not both); on ALR land the ALC allows one additional detached residence to 90 m² on ≤40 ha where conditions are met, without an application. Buildings in A-1/A-2 sited 15 m from watercourses/key ditches. OCP: "I See Pitt Meadows 2040"; North Lougheed Area Plan adopted by OCP Amendment Bylaw No. 3060, 2026 (~50 ha, gradual development, further approvals required).

Taxes/rebates/financing: PTT 1% / 2% / 3% plus a further 2% on the residential portion above $3M — any "Over $3M — 5%" line compresses 3% + 2%, flagged. Exemptions: first-time buyers full on first $500,000 at ≤$835,000, partial to $860,000; newly built full to $1,100,000, eliminated at $1,150,000. Example (input: $662,500 community attached median, no exemption): $2,000 + $9,250 = $11,250. FTHB GST rebate (Bill C-4, Royal Assent March 13, 2026 — never March 12): 100% to $1M, phasing to $1.5M, max $50,000, agreements Mar 20, 2025–2031; New Housing Rebate 36%, max $6,300, $350K–$450K phase-out; HBP $60,000; FHSA $40,000 / $8,000; CMHC premiums 0.6%–4.5%. GST on new construction, not resales (The Fairways is 2007 resale stock). Vancouver EHT does NOT apply.

blocks.text: Local rules that affect land buyers in North Meadows PI

items.t: OCP — "I See Pitt Meadows 2040": (Official Community Plan Bylaw No. 2864, 2020, per the land home's research), covering the whole city including this sub-area, plus the North Lougheed Area Plan, adopted by OCP Amendment Bylaw No. 3060, 2026 (~50 ha, gradual development, further approvals required).

Zoning — Zoning Bylaw No. 2505, 2011: A-1 General Agricultural — minimum lot area for subdivision 8 ha, one farm house per lot to a maximum gross floor area of 500 sq m; A-2 Large Lot Agricultural — minimum 16 ha; RR-2 Large Lot Rural Residential — minimum 4 ha; RR-3 — minimum 2 ha; RR-4 — minimum 1 ha (RR zones are for land outside the Agricultural Land Reserve); RS Large Lot Residential — minimum 0.2 ha. Zoning requires residential and agricultural buildings to be sited 15 m from watercourses, key ditches and constructed ditches in the A-1 and A-2 zones. Any specific parcel's zone and ALR status: per-parcel, not verified here. Bylaw No. 2505, 2011 - Consolidated Version_0.pdf

Second dwellings: a garden suite is permitted in the A-1, A-2, RR-1 to RR-5 and RS zones, one per lot, 33 sq m to 90 sq m, and a property may have a garden suite or a secondary suite, not both. On ALR land, the ALC allows one additional detached residence without an application where there is one existing residence when construction begins, to a maximum of 90 sq m on properties 40 ha or less.

Subdivision and servicing — Pitt Meadows number not confirmed: subdivision follows the zone minimums above and, where ALR applies, ALC approval (ALR block below). The Pitt Meadows servicing bylaw number is not confirmed — no number is quoted and no other city's bylaw is borrowed. Whether a given North Meadows lot is on municipal water/sewer or on a well and septic system is not confirmed per lot on an official source: Not verified. Well records can be checked in the provincial GWELLS application; an onsite sewerage system must comply with the Sewerage System Regulation and only an Authorized Person can design, install, repair, maintain or inspect it.

Floodplain — LIVE CONFLICT flagged: over 95% of the Pitt Meadows land base lies within the floodplain (City 2020 Business Plan — the figure these notes retire to); the city is almost entirely protected by 60 km of dikes, and the northern drainage areas (Alouette Pump Station catchment, Fenton, and the Pitt Polder catchment) are drained by floodboxes and pump stations because of low elevation, with the Codd Island Wetlands undiked floodplain wetlands. The GUIDE pages quote "over 85%" (City Financial Plan 2026–2030) — a genuine conflict between two City sources, never silently resolved.

Property transfer tax — worked example (inputs + tier math): on a $700,000 parcel purchase, fully residential, no exemption — 1% on the first $200,000 ($2,000) + 2% on $200,000–$700,000 ($10,000) = $12,000. Anchors: $500K→$8,000; $800K cap→$14,000 ($6,000 fully qualifying FTHB); $900K→$16,000; $1.0M→$18,000; $1.5M→$28,000; $2.0M→$38,000; $3.5M→$93,000 INCLUDING the further 2% tier over $3M (tiers: 1% to $200,000, 2% to $2,000,000, 3% above, plus a further 2% on the residential portion over $3,000,000).

items.t: OCP — "I See Pitt Meadows 2040," Official Community Plan Bylaw No. 2864, 2020: covering the whole city including this sub-area, plus the North Lougheed Area Plan, adopted by OCP Amendment Bylaw No. 3060, 2026, covering approximately 50 ha north of Lougheed Highway between Meadows Gardens Golf Course and Harris Road, with development to proceed gradually and further approvals required.

Zoning — Zoning Bylaw No. 2505, 2011: A-1 General Agricultural minimum lot area for subdivision 8 ha (one farm house per lot to a maximum gross floor area of 500 sq m); A-2 Large Lot Agricultural minimum 16 ha; RR-2 minimum 4 ha; RR-3 minimum 2 ha; RR-4 minimum 1 ha (RR zones are for land outside the ALR); RS Large Lot Residential minimum 0.2 ha. A garden suite is permitted in the A-1, A-2, RR-1 to RR-5 and RS zones, one per lot, 33 sq m to 90 sq m, and a property may have a garden suite or a secondary suite, not both. Any specific parcel's zone and ALR status: per-parcel, not verified.

Subdivision and servicing — Pitt Meadows: subdivision follows the zone minimums above and, where ALR applies, ALC approval (ALR block below). The Pitt Meadows servicing bylaw number is not confirmed — no number is quoted and no other city's bylaw is borrowed; the documented process is zone minimums + dike/drainage position, confirmed with the City for the parcel. Per-lot well/septic versus municipal services: Not verified.

ALR block (78% of the city in the ALR; this sub-area's rural ground is the ALR heartland — parcel status per-address, not verified here): subdivision within the ALR requires Agricultural Land Commission approval; ALR residences cannot be stratified (ALC Bulletin 09 s.6; SPA s.239; ALCA s.21(1)). Caps: principal ≤500 m², suite within principal only, additional residence 90 m² (≤40 ha) / 186 m² (>40 ha); the research also records the ALC path in its own terms — one additional detached residence without an application where there is one existing residence when construction begins, to a maximum of 90 sq m on properties 40 ha or less.

What trades is fee-simple Pitt Polder farm and rural parcels under A-1 / A-2 agricultural zoning and RR rural-residential zoning, plus Highland Park and Wildwood house lots under RS / RR zoning — parcel by parcel, with no named acreage subdivision, no bare-land strata acreage community and no presale acreage offering verified on any source.
The ground in North Meadows

items.t: Agricultural parcels: A-1 General Agricultural — minimum lot area for subdivision 8 ha, one farm house per lot to a maximum gross floor area of 500 sq m; A-2 Large Lot Agricultural — minimum 16 ha.
Rural-residential parcels: RR-2 Large Lot Rural Residential minimum 4 ha; RR-3 minimum 2 ha; RR-4 minimum 1 ha.

Second dwellings on acreage: a garden suite is permitted in the A-1, A-2, RR-1 to RR-5 and RS zones, one per lot, 33 sq m to 90 sq m, and a property may have a garden suite OR a secondary suite, not both.

Serviced vs unserviced: whether a given North Meadows lot is on municipal water/sewer or on a well and septic system is not confirmed per lot on an official source: Not verified. Well records can be checked in the provincial GWELLS application; an onsite sewerage system must comply with the Sewerage System Regulation and only an Authorized Person can design, install, repair, maintain or inspect it.

NOT North Meadows stock: Meadowland Village + the Meadowlands Housing Co-operative on Advent Road are board-classified CENTRAL Meadows, not North Meadows, even though Highland Park Elementary at 18961 Advent Road, across the street, IS in North Meadows.

blocks.text: Streets, schools and getting around North Meadows

items.t: Municipality: City of Pitt Meadows. The closest official planning name for its southern edge is the North Lougheed Area, approximately 50 ha north of Lougheed Highway between Meadows Gardens Golf Course and Harris Road.

Main streets: Lougheed Highway (south edge), Harris Road, Advent Road, Ford Road, McNeil Road and Old Dewdney Trunk Road, with agricultural Pitt Polder land to the north and east. Nearby areas: Central Meadows, Mid Meadows, South Meadows and West Meadows (same city), Maple Ridge across the Pitt River to the east, Port Coquitlam to the west. Search names: "North Meadows", "North Meadows PI", "Highland Park", "Wildwood", "Pitt Polder".

Transit and hazards in brief: R3 Lougheed Hwy RapidBus stops at Harris Road on the south edge; route 701 runs via Harris Road and Hammond Road; route 719 serves Wildwood Crescent and Hammond Road; no bus route serving the rural north itself was confirmed: Not verified. The city is almost entirely protected by 60 km of dikes and its land base lies in the Fraser Valley floodplain; the Pitt Polder catchment is drained by floodboxes and pump stations.

items.t: Floodplain: The northern drainage areas (Alouette Pump Station catchment, Fenton, and the Pitt Polder catchment) are drained by floodboxes and pump stations because of low elevation, and the Codd Island Wetlands are undiked floodplain wetlands.

blocks.text: Good to know about North Meadows

items.t: The board line on Advent Road cuts across the street: MLS data classes 18960 Advent Road (Meadowland Village) as Central Meadows while Highland Park Elementary at 18961 Advent Road — facing it — is in North Meadows. Anyone searching "55+ Pitt Meadows" by street will land on Advent Road; anyone searching by board sub-area will not find it under North Meadows.

Two near-identical names, two tenures, one street: Meadowland Village is the buyable 55+ strata; Meadowlands Housing Co-operative is a 55+ co-op where members hold shares and nothing is ever a strata sale. Both are Central Meadows stock, covered there — a North Meadows buyer will meet both names first.

Heritage ground in the rural north (City sources, read Nov 1, 2026): Heritage sites in the sub-area on the City register include the Japanese Canadian Hall, 19089 Advent Road, the Pitt Meadows School House, 13414 Harris Road (described by the City as the most intact of the three early school houses remaining in the city), and farm properties on Ford Road; the Codd Island Wetlands are undiked floodplain wetlands on the Alouette River on the City heritage register.

The rural north has no bus: Confirmed transit is all on the Lougheed/Harris south edge (R3, 701, 719); no bus route serving the rural north itself was confirmed on an official source — material for any buyer planning to age in place on a Pitt Polder parcel without driving.

Buildings in the farm zones sit back 15 m from water: Zoning Bylaw No. 2505, 2011 requires residential and agricultural buildings to be sited 15 m from watercourses, key ditches and constructed ditches in the A-1 and A-2 zones — a buildable-envelope fact that changes what a Polder parcel can actually hold.

Flood / ALR: The city is almost entirely protected by 60 km of dikes; the northern drainage areas (Alouette Pump Station catchment, Fenton, and the Pitt Polder catchment) are drained by floodboxes and pump stations because of low elevation, and the Codd Island Wetlands are undiked floodplain wetlands; 78% of the city's land falls within the Agricultural Land Reserve per the same Business Plan, with property-level ALR status confirmed per address.

faq.q: How many condo buildings does North Meadows have?

faq.a: No source checked states any age restriction, and listings describe it as suiting "downsizers, families & professionals alike," pet-friendly, with a kids room among the amenities — "resort-style" in the marketing does not mean age-restricted. Settle the bylaw question from the strata's registered bylaws and Form B.
faq.q: Is The Fairways a 55+ building? It sits on a golf course and gets marketed to downsizers.

faq.a: Verify against the strata plan (BCS2427) before relying on any count.
faq.q: How many homes are in The Fairways?

faq.a: Long-term, yes — strata rental-restriction bylaws have been void since November 24, 2022 anywhere in BC. Short-term rentals are different: Pitt Meadows prohibits STRs at the city level, a separate layer that the strata-law change does not remove.
faq.q: Can I rent out a Fairways unit?

faq.a: Yes — one. The Fairways (19673 and 19677 Meadow Gardens Way), a 268-home resort-style condominium complex by Magusta Development on the edge of Meadow Gardens Golf Course; unit listings record Apartment/Condo sub-type, built 2007, freehold strata.
faq.q: Is there really a condo complex in North Meadows?

faq.a: No source checked publishes a 55+ bylaw for it, and its listings market to families and professionals and list a kids playroom, gym and guest suites among the amenities — do not treat it as 55+. The registered-bylaw position is not confirmed until the Form B is read.

Listing-level evidence says yes: listings call it pet friendly, record "Cats OK", and one states "one dog or up to two cats welcome". Pet bylaws remain enforceable in BC, so the registered bylaws in the Form B package govern for a specific purchase.
faq.q: Are pets allowed at The Fairways?

faq.a: Only down to the zone minimums in Zoning Bylaw No. 2505, 2011 — 8 ha in A-1 and 16 ha in A-2 — and, where the parcel is in the ALR, only with ALC approval; depositing a strata plan is itself a subdivision. Price no split before both frames are checked.
faq.q: Can I subdivide a farm parcel?

faq.a: A garden suite is permitted in the A-1, A-2, RR and RS zones, one per lot at 33 to 90 sq m (or a secondary suite, not both), and on ALR land the ALC also allows one additional detached residence to 90 sq m on properties 40 ha or less where the conditions are met.
faq.q: Can an acreage lot have a second dwelling?

faq.a: No — short-term rentals are PROHIBITED in Pitt Meadows; STR accommodation is not a permitted use in the Zoning Bylaw. Do not price any parcel on STR income.
faq.q: Can I short-term rent the farmhouse or a cabin?
